Name: Ridgeside Village Marriage Candidate Portraits
Author: RaspberriKai
Description:
This mod provides alternative portraits for the marriage candidates from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village mod[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url]. 

﻿To Install:
1.﻿ Download the '[CP] Ridgeside Village Marriage Candidate Portraits' zip file.
2. Extract the file.
3. Copy/paste into your Stardew Valley > Mods folder.﻿

*I'm working on the remaining 2 RSV marriage candidates! I'll add them all at once in a future update.
